description: Renovate opens pull requests only for dev dependencies' minor and patch updates and GitHub Actions, which merge themselves once CI passes, and for lockfile maintenance, which waits for a person. Every other update waits on the Dependency Dashboard.

customManagers.description: zizmor, which CI runs with pipx, not as an action.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of dev dependencies open a pull request that merges itself once CI passes.
The workflows' actions, zizmor, and Bun (read from pnpm/setup's runtime input) update in one pull request that merges itself once CI passes, except a major.
The repository allows pnpm/setup at one commit only, so its update fails CI until a person allows the new commit.
prBodyNotes: Before this can pass CI, allow the new commit of pnpm/setup in Settings > Actions > General and in `ALLOWED` of `scripts/workflows.ts`, in place of the old one.

packageRules.description: Each peer of @sohedra/lynx and its dev copy wait on the dashboard, so a dev copy never moves past its peer range. Their entries are a signal to widen the peer by hand and are never approved. scripts/renovate.ts keeps this list equal to the peers.
The type tests' older TypeScript stays on 5.x.
Tailwind CSS 4 is not supported (support policy S8).
Lynx moves one version at a time, with the engine-upgrade checklist, in one pull request.
The released Svelte the tests compare with waits on the dashboard: its update is the sign that Svelte shipped custom renderers.
Svelte's custom-renderer build is pinned to a pkg.svelte.dev URL on purpose; a person moves it. Released Svelte, as the docs use, still updates.
engines.node follows the support policy, by hand.
